summary_scope.name: 典型泛化场景 / representative generalization scenarios
summary_scope.weighting: equal weight per unique physical point; aliases count once
summary_scope.supplementary_status: retained in detailed tables, not included in headline summary
summary_scope.note: User-requested post-release reporting cohort; not a new measurement or proof of universal generalization. Six supplementary QwenDense points per QKV direction; OProj unchanged.

acceptance: User accepted current measured performance; not all original numeric targets are met.

measurement.selection: fixed whole matrices, no per-point faster-source mixing

boundaries.forward: dynamic BF16 master-weight quantization + GEMM + A2A + synchronization; upstream activation quantization excluded
boundaries.backward: complete immediate B+dW five-kernel Graph including all three preparations, GEMMs and routing; upstream gradient quantization and caller-owned cross-CP dW reduction excluded

limitations: Qwen3 CP8 QKV forward/backward requires unimplemented KV replication: all three sequences excluded explicitly.
Kimi labels are supported projection geometries, not full special KDA routing.
No new MLA/KDA-special route, norm/RoPE backward or full-model training validation.
Norm/RoPE remains default-off experimental; old experimental numerical failures are not claimed fixed.
Explicit manual GEMM/communication configurations, not new Auto or globally optimal candidates.
Forward table is the earlier fixed two-payload confirmation; backward prefetch is newly confirmed on all69 points. Do not call forward rows fresh measurements of the prefetch binary.
Forward cuBLASLt columns are historical; backward reference is an independently measured sum of two pure GEMM times, not fused E2E.

forward_integration.scope: targeted integration on prefetch source; not replacements for the fixed forward table

rejected_setup_runs.reason: Missing explicit N256 benchmark binding; entry rejected, no valid measurement

raw_evidence: fuse_midfile/l20d/<run>/artifacts-attempt1; local source snapshots and cloud formal archives retained

replay.instructions: Build the correct variant, then append a row's replay_args to run_prefix. No historical source-run or online search is required.

pure_cublaslt_backward_reference.scope: full148SM single-GPU pure cuBLASLt; prequantized operands; no quantization/communication/CP reduction; two payloads each10+50; backward equivalent time sums two independent GEMMs
